source_clock: Media presentation timestamps, not new real interaction, simulator time or learner wall clock
scope: Exactly nine already retained original frames inspected via view_image; no new extraction, crop, resize, render, detector execution or pixel fitting. Whole video remains construction partition.
annotation_type: Sparse descriptive visual review, not geometric ground truth or causal control labels
unreviewed_gaps: Every interval between these sparse frames remains unreviewed. No hidden result, control transition, vehicle change chronology, uninterrupted episode or map continuity is inferred. Root separately reviews 0..40 s.
method_limitations: Media PTS is video presentation time, not OS input time, source gameplay physics time or learner wall clock.
HUD progress text and mission/flag/crown values are transcriptions of visible UI, not terminal outcome scores. Fuel-icon bar text semantics are not inferred beyond visible appearance.
Moving face-camera overlay, left black border, transient text, smoke and coin sprites can occlude geometry.
Visible touch-style circles and pedal deformation can be construction evidence for a future validated visual input indicator, but are not keydown, held-duration or simultaneous-action truth.

Vehicle names are visually verified only where text appears in selected menu frames. Appearance matches to other frames are explicit inferences; map names and build/configuration identity are not established here.

The green tractor has substantially unequal wheel sizes and a different body color. Existing red-body/near-equal-wheel assumptions and native 1034x581 geometry are not calibrated for these 1280x576 video images.
Review receipt timestamps are creation times after direct inspection; per-frame viewing duration was not instrumented. No complete video or complete episode review is claimed.
